title: Keep a working version
body: Choose Keep this version from an app's menu to leave it out of automatic updates and Update all. You can still update it by hand, or choose Allow updates when you're ready.

title: Updates that find their way
body: Shoal now follows renamed apps, so Angelfish and Butterflyfish updates reach you, bringing their new names and icons. A new setup screen covers battery optimisation and background updates, and it's in Settings if you want it again.

title: A tidier shoal
body: Squill now leads the list, Swordfish is now Angelfish, and Blobfish is now Butterflyfish. Your installed copies carry on updating as normal. Clownfish and Pufferfish are archived for now, so Shoal no longer lists or updates them.

title: Shine and bubbles
body: Touch a fish in your list, or hover over it, for a shine and a few bubbles.

title: Your apps, even offline
body: Shoal remembers the last checked releases when offline or Data Saver pauses checks. Already downloaded APKs can be installed offline after the usual signature checks. New downloads respect Wi-Fi-only settings and Data Saver throughout the transfer.

title: Know what changed
body: Shoal now shows release notes once after each app update. Open them again in Settings whenever you like.

title: Works offline
body: The notes are included with your installed version, with no extra network requests.
